Pack
Series A · AI & Machine Learning · Barcelona, Spain · Founded 2022 · 30–35 employees
Pack is an AI-native People Development Platform that helps large enterprises democratize data-driven people development by mapping, assessing, and developing human skills 10x faster than existing solutions. The startup integrates skill mapping, digital assessments, and personalized development pathways including coaching, mentoring, and targeted training, supported by continuous AI-based monitoring. Founded in 2022, Pack has raised €5.8 million in Series A funding and works with over 80 multinational companies including Lecta, LG Electronics, and Cooltra, achieving a 94% satisfaction rate. The company operates from Barcelona as part of its European expansion strategy while maintaining Italian roots.
